simple.summary: אֻזֵּן שֶׁאֱרָה (ʼUzzên Sheʼĕrâh) means Uzzen-Sheerah , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Chr 7 24.

definitions.full: H242. Uzzen Sheerah שֶׁאֱרָה אֻזֵּן proper name, of a location ( portion — weighed & measured — of She'§ra , Blau ZMG 1873, 296 ), place built by ׳שׁ , daughter of Ephraim 1Chr 7:24 . אֲזִקִּים see זקק .
definitions.rootNote: from 238 and 7609 ; plot of Sheerah (i.e. settled by him);
